definition: סִבֹּ֫לֶת noun feminine probably ear of wheat , etc., only Judg 12:6 dialect form of II. שִׁבֹּלֶת q. v. (> = late word שִׁבֹּ֫לֶת tide, flood ); compare Marquardt ZAW viii (1888), 151 ff. but also GFM Bu .
